summary: Claude made the one-line heading edit directly in index.html with no brainstorming skill, no go-ahead request, and no consequence-raising.
reasoning: The request was handled as a single local edit within ~13s, verified both on screen and in the on-disk file and session log. No over-trigger behavior observed.

observations.description: Agent noted it left <title>Reports</title> unchanged — a reasonable, one-line clarification, though some users might consider the title part of 'the page heading'.
Spinner label read 'Sautéed for 13s · done 1:11 AM' — whimsical status wording that may confuse users scanning for progress state.
Launch required stepping through four separate onboarding/consent screens (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions) before any prompt could be entered.

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming skill; no go-ahead request or consequence raised

Final assistant message was purely informational: "Changed the <h1> in index.html:5 to \"Quarterly Reports\". Left the <title> as \"Reports\" since you asked only for the page heading."
